name: AWC Berhad
overview: 今年 AWC 与 TwinMatrix Technologies 签订谅解备忘录，探索设施与基础设施运营的数字化创新，但截至最新公告该 MOU 尚无实质进展；同时公司对印尼间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution 启动自愿清盘解散，该公司为休眠状态。此外，公司完成凭单发行等企业活动，业务板块本身未见新增或缩减。
overview_en: This year AWC entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with TwinMatrix Technologies to explore digital innovation across its facilities and infrastructure operations, though no material development has been announced as of the latest update; meanwhile, the company commenced voluntary liquidation and dissolution of its indirect wholly-owned Indonesian subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution, which is dormant.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 与 TwinMatrix Technologies 签订谅解备忘录，探索设施与基础设施运营的数字化创新，目前尚无实质进展。
segments.note_en: Entered into an MOU with TwinMatrix Technologies to explore digital innovation across facilities and infrastructure operations, with no material development to date.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告该谅解备忘录仍无实质进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that the MOU still has no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 再次公告该谅解备忘录尚无实质进展。
actions.text_en: Announced again that there has been no material development on the MOU.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告该谅解备忘录自签署以来尚无实质进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that there has been no material development on the MOU since it was signed.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 TwinMatrix Technologies Pte. Ltd. 签订不具约束力的谅解备忘录，探索利用数据驱动和 AI 系统推进设施与基础设施运营的数字化转型。
actions.text_en: Entered into a non-binding MOU with TwinMatrix Technologies Pte. Ltd. to explore digital transformation initiatives using data-driven and AI-enabled systems across facilities and infrastructure operations.

segments.name: 环境服务
segments.note: 对印尼间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution 启动自愿清盘解散，该公司为休眠公司。
segments.note_en: Commenced voluntary liquidation and dissolution of indirect wholly-owned Indonesian subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution, a dormant company.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution（印尼休眠公司，实缴资本约 RM1.639 million）启动自愿清盘及解散程序。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution (a dormant Indonesian company with paid-up capital of approximately RM1.639 million) commenced voluntary liquidation and dissolution.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过自愿清盘解散印尼间接全资子公司 PT Stream Environment Solution，退出该休眠实体。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the dormant Indonesian indirect wholly-owned subsidiary PT Stream Environment Solution through voluntary liquidation and dissolution.
